title: Quickest Change-point Detection in Generalized Linear Models with Variational Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider quickest change-point detection in generalized linear models when the post-change parameter is unknown. Such problems arise, for example, when monitoring whether the relationship between a learned representation and an observed response changes over time. Since detection must occur soon after a change, the post-change parameter must be estimated from a limited number of observations, making finite-sample estimation accuracy particularly important. We propose a window-limited CUSUM procedure that estimates the post-change parameter using a variational-inequality (VI) formulation. For noncanonical links, VI estimation can offer favorable finite-sample accuracy over short windows despite the asymptotic efficiency advantage of maximum likelihood estimation. We characterize how estimation error reduces the effective post-change information rate and affects detection delay, and derive finite-window guarantees accounting for both

translated_title: 基于变分估计的广义线性模型最快变点检测
translated_abstract: 我们研究了广义线性模型中变化后参数未知时的最快变点检测问题。这类问题出现在诸如监控学习到的表示与观测响应之间的关系是否随时间变化的场景中。由于检测必须在变化发生后尽快进行，变化后参数只能从有限的观测数据中估计，因此有限样本估计精度尤为重要。我们提出了一种窗口受限的CUSUM检测方法，该方法利用变分不等式（VI）形式来估计变化后参数。对于非规范链接函数，尽管极大似然估计具有渐近效率优势，但VI估计在短窗口下能够提供更优的有限样本精度。我们刻画了估计误差如何降低变化后的有效信息率并影响检测延迟，并推导了同时考虑上述两个因素的有限窗口性能保证。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于变分不等式估计的窗口受限CUSUM方法，用于变化后参数未知的广义线性模型最快变点检测，并刻画了估计误差对检测延迟的影响且给出了有限窗口下的性能保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a window-limited CUSUM procedure with variational-inequality estimation for quickest change-point detection in generalized linear models with unknown post-change parameters, characterizing how estimation error affects detection delay and providing finite-window guarantees.
